text:
Aisha R (Partnerships): Heads-up: Nimbus Labs (hardware partner) wants a LangChain + gateway onramp for a joint marketplace bundle. They asked for a short sandbox, perf numbers, and co-marketing assets for early Q3.

Tom B (Eng): From eng: scope? LangChain adapter + a tiny retrieval sample or full LlamaIndex support? Also need supported model list.

Aisha R (Partnerships): LangChain adapter + LlamaIndex basic retrieval example. Nimbus will run tests on their rtx-A6200 fleet; we need a validated perf profile and a note on kernel compatibility.

Rosa M (DevEx): I'll scaffold a demo repo and a GH workflow that deploys the gateway and sample app. Can have a PR by Wed.

Eli W (Product): Marketplace checklist: SKU options, fallback policies, support matrix, and a short security note for Private deployments. I'll draft SKU copy by next Tue.

Dana K (Marketing): Need a 1-pager and a 60s co-demo script. What launch window are they thinking?

Aisha R (Partnerships): Nimbus hinted at late July. We should lock tech sign-off two weeks prior. Sam, legal review timeline?

Sam L (Legal): Send the draft coop wording and a dataflow diagram. Recommend "Validated with Nimbus Labs" phrasing until full cert. Will finish review within 5 business days of receiving docs.

Tom B (Eng): Perf matrix to run: redwood-7b, redwood-13b-q4; seq 512 & 1024; batch sizes 1 & 4. PerfBot please queue tag: nimbus-2468.

PerfBot: Perf job queued. Provide GCS path and prompt CSV.

Rosa M (DevEx): Uploading prompts to gs://redwood-partners/nimbus-2468 and opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-repo/nimbus-langchain-demo/pull/4

Eli W (Product): Add fallback text: automatic fallback to quantized 13B or hosted variant under capacity stress. Include that in the marketplace copy.

Aisha R (Partnerships): Action recap:
- Tom: perf runs + compat notes (due TOM)
- Rosa: demo repo + prompts (PR opened)
- Eli: SKU + marketplace copy (due Tue)
- Sam: legal review after dataflow (5 business days)
- Dana: marketing assets after perf (60s script + 1-pager)

Aisha R (Partnerships): Let's reconvene next Wed 9am PT to review perf and PR. Thanks everyone!
